objective: Three fixes the human asked for on 2026-11-07: the labelled sidebar's current-page bar no longer overlaps its icon, the game view loses its matchup artwork, and the composer loses its Quick posts section.
acceptance_criteria: Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation; the implementation commit edits no test.

Sidebar, from 53.75em (860 px) to below 78em (1248 px): the current page's bar (the 3 px inline-start border on .link[aria-current=page]) and that link's icon do not overlap, with at least 8 px (--space-2) between the bar's inline end and the icon's inline start. Measured in Chrome at 860, 1000, 1217 and 1247 px on the current link.

The sidebar's geometry is otherwise unchanged: every label still fits on one line inside --sidebar-width at 860 px and 200 % text keeps no horizontal overflow; below 53.75em (icon-only sidebar, bottom bar) and from 78em nothing moves (positions compared before and after at 640, 800 and 1280 px).

The game view, page and modal alike, no longer renders the matchup artwork: features/games/MatchupArtwork.tsx is deleted, its CSS rules (.matchupArtwork, .artLabels, .artTeam, .artDate) are removed, and nothing imports or names it. The article's children are, in order: the header, the line score (when the game has one) and the Team box scores tabs. Nothing else changes in them.

The composer (page and modal) no longer has a Quick posts section: no 'Quick posts' heading and no template buttons. features/compose/PostTemplate.ts and its test are deleted, the section's CSS rules are removed, and ComposeMediator.loadDraft is removed if nothing else calls it. Code comments that describe the templates are corrected.

Every other composer path is unchanged: typing, mentions, images, the stats attachment, 'Post about this game' prefill, the rate-limit message and posting. Existing tests for them pass unedited, except tests whose only subject is the removed artwork or templates, which are deleted in the test commit.

wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08-frontend.md no longer describes MatchupArtwork or the quick-post templates (Prototype row included). The Standards gof-patterns.md Prototype line is a Director follow-up, named in the PR.

The full frontend suite (vitest --maxWorkers=2), npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm run build pass. The bundle-budget test passes with this unit's own file in frontend/src/test/bundle-budgets/ declaring every output it changes; no other unit's file is edited.

Browser rows (FrontendUI/verification.md), Chrome, light and dark, at 320, 360, 768 and 1280 px unless a criterion names other widths: each row measured or reported NOT DONE in the PR, with no document-level horizontal overflow and no page error. Rows: the sidebar bar at the widths above; a game with a line score and one without, page and modal; the composer page and modal, signed in on localhost.
